messages:
sam.hall: Quick heads-up: publishing wasm-edge-sdk v1.0.0-rc1 to npm and the docs site now. This is our lightweight edge client (WASM) for browser/worker runtimes. :sparkles:

devx-bot: npm publish: redwood-wasm-edge@1.0.0-rc1 -> registry (dist-tag: next)

anya: Nice! Does this replace the browser SDK bundle or is it opt-in?

sam.hall: Opt-in. We keep the main JS SDK unchanged. wasm-edge is a separate package with a smaller runtime and no native binaries. Good for Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, and static embeds.

zara: Docs question: do we have migration notes for apps that relied on window.Buffer or Node globals? A lot of examples assume Node.

sam.hall: Yes, migration guide added: docs#8244. Highlights: use the runtime shim `rw-wasm-shim` or switch to the async fetch adapter. We added examples for Workers and a minimal fallback for older browsers.

docs-bot: docs-site deploy: v4.1.0 -> staging (includes wasm-edge docs and migration guide)

anya: Telemetry/privacy check: wasm in-browser demos will execute in the user's origin. Are we sending any host telemetry by default? Partners will ask.

sam.hall: Important note: wasm-edge demos are telemetry-off by default for embeds. We changed the docs runner policy: embeds must set `allow_telemetry=true` explicitly when requesting ephemeral tokens. Default is false. This is a docs + product change.

zara: Phew. Can we add a short blurb in the Quickstart about this, and a snippet showing how to request ephemeral tokens with the flag?

sam.hall: Already added. Example (Workers):
```
// fetch an ephemeral token with explicit telemetry consent
await fetch("https://auth.redwood.ai/ephemeral", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ embed: true, allow_telemetry: true })
});
```

anya: Will there be changes required for the examples repo CI? Our test runner currently curls the public quickstart with a static demo token.

sam.hall: CI needs a tiny change: switch to the runner helper `rw-docs ci-token` which exchanges a service key for a short-lived token. docs#8246 contains the script.

devx-bot: gha: workflow 'examples-ci' triggered -> uses rw-docs@v0.5.2 for token exchange

zara: Anything breaking in the main JS SDK surface? I know many teams import types from '@redwood/sdk'.

sam.hall: No breaking surface changes in the main JS SDK. We added new types for edge client in `@redwood/wasm-edge` package. Type-only imports so most TS projects won't need changes unless they opt-in.

anya: Release cadence? When does rc1 become GA?

sam.hall: RC1 for testing this week. GA planned next Tuesday (2169600000 ~ 2026-04-28). If blockers found we'll push. Please test Workers / Deno snippets and the Quickstart.

zara: I'll run through the examples and check for any residual Node globals and report back by Friday.

docs-bot: PRs: docs#8244 (migration guide), docs#8246 (CI token helper), examples#142 (Workers demo). Staging deployed.

sam.hall: Action items: 1) Docs reviewers please review docs#8244 + #8246 (anya, zara) 2) DevX to sanity-check npm publish and CI (devx) 3) QA: smoke test Workers + Deno demos (zara). Target GA next week.

anya: Ack. I'll review now.

sam.hall: Thanks team — posting short partner note after GA and a small quickstart banner calling out the opt-in telemetry requirement for embeds.
